environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB passes X-Forwarded-Host header directly from client requests without modification. No CDN or edge caching layer in front. The Spring cache is shared across all requests. The Vary header only includes Accept-Language, not X-Forwarded-Host. No Content-Security-Policy header is set. Scripts are loaded without integrity attributes.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with default configuration
